test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
In the following passage, some words have been deleted. Read the passage carefully and select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks.

The touch-sensitive surface is one of the reasons why tablets and smart phones are so smart. All touchscreens generate an electric field __________ the screen. Your finger interferes with the field, and the device's operating system __________ your touch or swipe.
solution:
The correct answer is '**across; follows**'.

 

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**across the screen**" is the appropriate choice as it implies the electric field being generated over the surface of the screen.
 
• The word "**follows**" fits well in the context as the operating system detects and responds to the user’s input.
 
• The other options: "**past; attends**," "**beyond; escorts**," and "**onto; chases**" do not fit the context or usual terminology associated with touchscreen technology.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The touch-sensitive surface is one of the reasons why tablets and smart phones are so smart. All touchscreens generate an electric field across__ the screen. Your finger interferes with the field, and the device's operating system __follows__ your touch or swipe.*

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Past**: implies moving by something or to a position further on in time.
 
• **Beyond**: suggests something that is further away or outside the range.
 
• **Onto**: implies movement to a position on a surface.
 
• **Attends**: means to be present at.
 
• **Escorts**: means to accompany someone or something somewhere.
 
• **Chases**: means to pursue with intent to catch up.
